description: Advanced CLI Orchestration Skill Registry - Maps natural language intents to complex CLI workflows including chaining, pipelines, parallel execution, and conditional branching patterns.

skills.name: Fetch Customer Data
skills.description: Retrieve raw customer data from the data source. Returns customer records with ID, name, tier level (GOLD/SILVER/PLATINUM/BRONZE), spending amount, and region. Use this as the first stage in customer analysis pipelines.

skills.name: Fetch Transaction Data
skills.description: Retrieve transaction records from the data source. Returns transactions with ID, customer ID, amount, status (COMPLETED/PENDING/FAILED), and date. Use for financial analysis and transaction processing workflows.

skills.name: Filter Data by Field
skills.description: Filter incoming data stream by specific field criteria. Supports filtering by TIER (customer level), STATUS (transaction state), or REGION (geographic area). This processor CLI accepts piped input and outputs filtered results.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Field name to filter on (TIER, STATUS, REGION)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to filter for (e.g., GOLD, COMPLETED, WEST)

skills.name: Count Records by Field
skills.description: Aggregate and count records grouped by a specific field. Supports counting by TIER (customer tiers) or STATUS (transaction statuses). This aggregator CLI accepts piped input and outputs count summaries.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: Field to group and count by (TIER or STATUS)

skills.name: Calculate Field Statistics
skills.description: Compute statistical measures (count, sum, average, min, max) for numeric fields. Supports AMOUNT (transaction amounts) and SPENDING (customer spending). This aggregator CLI processes piped input and outputs statistical analysis.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: Numeric field to analyze (AMOUNT or SPENDING)

skills.name: Customer Tier Analysis Workflow
skills.description: Execute complete customer tier analysis workflow. This orchestrates a CLI chain: fetch_customers → filter_by TIER GOLD → count_by TIER. Demonstrates basic chaining pattern for customer segmentation analysis.

skills.name: Transaction Analytics Workflow
skills.description: Execute transaction analytics workflow with chaining. Orchestrates: fetch_transactions → filter_by STATUS COMPLETED → calculate_stats AMOUNT. Provides revenue analysis and transaction performance metrics.

skills.name: Multi-Stage Data Pipeline
skills.description: Execute sophisticated multi-stage data pipeline with regional filtering and enrichment. Chain: fetch_customers → filter_by REGION → transform_data ENRICH → count_by TIER. Demonstrates complex data transformation workflows.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Target region for filtering (WEST, EAST, NORTH, SOUTH)

examples: run multi-stage pipeline for WEST region

skills.name: Parallel Data Processing
skills.description: Execute multiple data sources in parallel for performance optimization. Concurrently fetches customers, transactions, and metrics, then processes each stream independently. Demonstrates parallel execution pattern.

patterns.chaining: Output of one CLI becomes input to next CLI (e.g., fetch | filter | count)
patterns.parallel: Concurrent execution of independent CLI operations for performance
patterns.conditional: Dynamic workflow branching based on CLI output analysis
